evidence.frequency_or_severity: Every nontrivial implemented change needs trustworthy behavioral evidence and independent review; stale review evidence and invented plan decisions are high-severity failures.

job: Take an implementation-ready plan through test-driven implementation, verification, fresh-context review, bounded remediation, and a release-ready decision.

rejected_alternatives: Repository instructions cannot express a reusable cross-repository lifecycle.
A prose-only skill cannot safely enforce state order or stale-evidence invalidation.
Research, architecture planning, and deployment are separate jobs.

positive_triggers: Explicit request to ship an approved implementation plan.
Request to manage implementation through TDD and independent review.
Validated handoff containing settled requirements and design decisions.
negative_triggers: Architecture or program design with unresolved consequential decisions.
inputs: Acceptance criteria, non-goals, constraints, and required verification.
outputs: Release-ready candidate or an exact stopped-state handoff.
default: Modify locally, require fresh independent review, and stop at release-ready without committing, pushing, merging, publishing, or deploying.
forbidden_effects: Invent unresolved requirements or architecture decisions.
Overwrite user work or expand scope.
completion_checks: Plan and readiness artifacts remain unchanged.
Acceptance criteria and repository-required checks pass.
The candidate has a fresh independent pass review.
The deterministic state validator reports release-ready.
